bullets: Architected an AI validation gate that checks every model response against a strict Zod schema, automatically rejecting and retrying outputs with missing fields, invalid values, or hallucinated content so only complete, correctly structured answers reach users.

Cut result-matching time from ∼3 min to ∼2 s (∼90x faster) by replacing a chain of rate-limited LLM calls with a semantic embedding matcher and rule-based checks that score every result in a single batched call.

Hardened the backend by migrating 14 API routes to Firebase Cloud Functions, moving API keys out of application code into Secret Manager, and adding Redis-backed per-user and per-IP rate limits to block abusive traffic before it could overload the server.

Closed a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in rendered source links by validating untrusted backend responses and rejecting non-HTTP(S) URLs, preventing malicious scripts from running in users’ browsers.

Gave the team real-time visibility into production failures by adding Sentry error monitoring and structured Pino logging across 12 route handlers, surfacing issues in an owner dashboard so bugs were caught before users reported them.
tech: TypeScript, Node.js, Firebase Cloud Functions, Redis, Zod, Sentry, Pino
